archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast mixed with Luxury (Dark Blue Variant)
description: A highly professional, trustworthy, and modern Nigerian investment platform. Uses deep authoritative blues and crisp whites to signal financial security and premium service. The UI prioritizes data clarity and high contrast.

headings.usage: H1 to H6 headings, large metrics.
headings.rules: Must use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for sizes above 32px. No Inter allowed for headings. Font weights: 400 (Light for elegance), 600 (Semibold), 800 (Black for impact).

body.usage: Paragraphs, data tables, labels, form inputs.
body.rules: Standard line-height (leading-relaxed). Highly legible for financial data and numbers.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used exclusively for sticky headers or floating navigation. Apply backdrop-blur-xl, bg-[#020813]/70, and a delicate 1px border-[#1A2B44] at the bottom.
visual_enhancers.grid_borders: For Admin Dashboards: expose the skeleton. Use border-collapse and border-b border-r border-[#1A2B44] on grid items for a highly technical, data-dense look.
visual_enhancers.cards: Dashboard and Investment Product cards should use flat solid surfaces (bg-[#0B1524]) with a crisp 1px border (border-[#1A2B44]). No muddy soft shadows. Use subtle glow or translation on hover.
visual_enhancers.glow: Primary CTAs (like 'Invest' or 'Deposit') can have a subtle box-shadow glow using the primary color to draw the eye.

grids_and_layouts.marketing_pages: Asymmetrical Bento grids with generous spacing (p-12 to p-32). Overlap elements slightly to break standard bootstrap columns.
grids_and_layouts.user_dashboard: High Density Bento Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4). Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6). Use h-full so widgets stretch to match neighbors.
grids_and_layouts.admin_dashboard: Strict layout with a fixed sidebar (w-64) and main content area. Dense data tables with crisp alignment.
grids_and_layouts.spacing_rules: Always add internal padding (p-6 or p-8) inside bordered containers to prevent text collision.

motion.interactive: Slight lift (-translate-y-1) and border color change on hover for clickable cards.
motion.transitions: Use specific properties ONLY: transition-colors, transition-transform duration-200 ease. NEVER use 'transition-all'.
motion.loading: Use skeleton loaders matching the exact shape of the delayed content.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards against deep blue backgrounds.
accessibility.focus: All focusable elements must have focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0055FF] focus:outline-none.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs) MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or slightly rounded (rounded-md) with bold typography and interaction animations.
components.tables: Shadcn UI tables customized for dark mode. Left-align most columns, right-align monetary figures.
components.forms: Shadcn UI form components. Never use native inputs directly. Inputs should have bg-[#121E30] and border-[#1A2B44].
components.toasts: Use Sonner for all notifications (success, error, copy to clipboard).

images.description: Nigerian businessman smiling. Use on the landing page or welcome screen to build trust and local connection.
Stock market candlestick chart on a dark screen. Matches the dark blue tech vibe perfectly.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a modern Nigerian investment platform with a deep dark blue theme as requested.
Do NOT use HTML components for advanced interactions; use Shadcn UI.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds on dropdowns or overlays.
Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide Icons for crisp, technical UI elements.
Implement the 3-generation referral logic visually in the User Dashboard (display earnings and active refs).
Admin Dashboard must include settings for referral percentages, product CRUD, deposit/withdrawal management, and welcome bonus config.
User frontend must include Wallet, Active Investments, Marketplace, and a Redeem Coupon section.
Ensure the Welcome Bonus of ₦500 is prominently displayed for new users.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Use the custom colors and fonts defined above.
Create depth through layered design elements (z-index hierarchy).
Do not center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned).
Always use modern button styles with proper interaction states.
Never use AI assistant Emojis for icons.
Ensure robust data-testid attributes are added to all interactive elements.
